name: [💚PLOTS] Horrific Housing
desc:
Just for a bit of fun.

Can you survive a laundry list of exciting randomly chosen disasters? All you have is a small floating plot of land with a house - are you able to out live your opponents?

pls thumb up 👍 and favourite ⭐

llm.loop: spawn on a floating plot with a house -> survive randomly chosen disasters -> outlast opponents -> earn tokens for cosmetics/upgrades
llm.objectives: be the last survivor on your plot through a series of random disasters
llm.progression: tokens, house style/ornament chests, badges, premium upgrades
llm.instructions: survive a list of randomly chosen disasters on your small floating plot and outlive your opponents
unique: each player defends a personal floating house plot against disasters
llm.thumbnails: classic noob avatar panicking beside a red house with flaming jack-o'-lantern, numbered 1-2-3 disaster sequence, house hit by tidal wave
llm.complexity_notes: simple plots and houses, scripted disaster events; long-running game with many disaster variants
